arguments.sql:
SELECT target.Id, target.PostTypeId, link.LinkTypeId, source.Id AS source_id, source.PostTypeId AS source_type, source.Tags, source.Score
FROM posts AS target
LEFT JOIN postLinks AS link ON link.RelatedPostId = target.Id
LEFT JOIN posts AS source ON source.Id = link.PostId
WHERE target.Title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?'

      FROM postLinks AS link
      JOIN posts AS target ON target.Id = link.RelatedPostId
      WHERE target.PostTypeId = 1
        AND target.Title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?'
  )
LIMIT 1
